approach: Use wails dev as the single repository-root development entry and configure Wails to own frontend install, build, watcher, bindings, and Go launch. Use the same Go composition root in the packaged app so it owns player-server and optional-tunnel readiness, failure unwinding, and shutdown.

decisions.decision: Use wails dev as the sole development startup command and the packaged app launch as the sole release entry
decisions.why: Wails project configuration already orchestrates frontend tooling, while one Go composition root can own the player listener and tunnel in both modes
decisions.rejected: Make/npm wrapper or separately launched frontend and player-server commands

decisions.decision: Keep the Electron rollback runtime and stop before T064
decisions.why: The cutover gate requires a Developer ID signed, notarized, stapled, Gatekeeper-accepted DMG; this host has zero signing identities
decisions.rejected: Deleting legacy sources based only on an ad-hoc unsigned app

decisions.decision: Use one author-level [hidden] rule with !important for all player state containers
decisions.why: It makes hidden layout exclusion authoritative across class-level display declarations

decisions.decision: Use personal-use macOS app acceptance as the active cutover profile
decisions.why: The owner currently needs the app only on their own Mac and no Developer ID identity is available; local/ad-hoc package evidence already exists
decisions.rejected: Keeping Electron deletion blocked on optional public-distribution credentials

decisions.decision: Use the accepted ad-hoc-signed Apple Silicon app as the active personal-use cutover profile
decisions.why: The owner needs personal use and all personal integrity, launch, storage, shutdown, and P1 gates passed
decisions.rejected: Blocking cutover on unavailable Developer ID and notarization credentials

decisions.decision: Retain the window.electronAPI JavaScript name only as a compatibility facade over generated Wails bindings
decisions.why: It preserves master UI behavior while removing Electron and Node privileges
decisions.rejected: Rewrite the mature master UI around a new frontend API during runtime migration

decisions.decision: Use immutable Git commit 9b2dd022a724202f95766d8196cc3fdf88be9084 as the canonical Electron rollback source
decisions.why: No independently archived Electron binary exists for this checkout, while the commit and lock file reproduce the accepted oracle
decisions.rejected: Retain deleted Electron sources and dependency tree in the active Wails branch

decisions.decision: Use a Darwin inherited owner-pipe guardian for ngrok
decisions.why: kernel pipe closure survives Wails dev supervisor termination that bypasses the native shutdown callback
decisions.rejected: relying only on App.OnShutdown, which BUG-003 proved can be skipped

decisions.decision: Publish the final narrow facade as window.desktopAPI
decisions.why: retains the accepted command/event behavior without an obsolete Electron runtime name
decisions.rejected: keeping the transitional window.electronAPI alias after cutover

decisions.decision: Use commit 118ed8199a3a0b1c3b73a09ef98908949c2e2d75 and executable digest d1ad65f5e5a80f3471e2d551d0ca5d1e55a8d2447cef58091a37cb35276cc121 as the canonical personal-use candidate
decisions.why: it is the exact post-Electron source commit containing all BUG-002 through BUG-004 code fixes
decisions.rejected: the stale pre-fix d95e144/84a998 candidate record
